answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an island bet on surviving 63 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the lantern schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 63 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
